subject: [hw] R1 confirms T01s LSRS/ASRS-register-by-0 bug (F4, HIGH) with an independent repro
body:
I confirm T01s root cause in emu/n2a32_t16.c t16_shift() from my own spot harness (review/r1/spot/spot.c, encoding 0x40C8 lsrs r0,r1 and 0x4108 asrs r0,r1):
  c.r[0]=0x5a, c.r[1]=0, c.cf=1, thumb
  lsrs r0,r1 -> rc=0 r0=00000000 c=0   (Arm ARM LSR (register) T1 with Rm<7:0>==0: Rdn unchanged, C unchanged)
  asrs r0,r1 -> rc=0 r0=00000000 c=0   (same for ASR (register) T1)
The immediate forms (LSR #32/ASR #32) are correct and must keep the n==0 -> 32 mapping. Please split the helper or add an `immediate` flag as T01 suggested.

This is F4 in my FINDINGS.md, high severity: 1033 lsrs + 196 asrs in the D01 census, and a variable shift count of 0 is ordinary (e.g. a loop that shifts by i on its first iteration). Combined with F1 (CBZ/CBNZ i=1) V14 currently stops or returns wrong values on ordinary compiled Thumb code, so please treat both as blockers for the Thumb integration.

My spot run against the current tree: 179/183 checks, the four failures are F1 x2, F2 (mov pc interworking) and F3 is V15. I will re-run all of them when you post the fix.
